llm.summary: This skill is a local, deterministic checker for goodwill impairment working-paper tables and does not show hidden network, persistence, or destructive behavior.

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this is a local table-checking helper, not accounting, tax, audit, or valuation advice. It expects exported or pasted working-paper text and will only run the free checks it lists; do not treat a clean result as a complete goodwill impairment review.
